newsitem.title: CHINA: HK AIRPORT PROGRAMME 85 PCT COMPLETE - GOVT.
newsitem.headline: HK AIRPORT PROGRAMME 85 PCT COMPLETE - GOVT.

text.p: Hong Kong's HK$156.4 billion airport core programme (ACP) comprising the construction of a new international airport and related core facilities is 85 percent complete, the government said on Friday. Government works in the programme are 98 percent complete, it said in a statement. New Airport Projects Co-ordination Office director Billy Lam said the office is working with related organisations to ensure the airport and the railway linking it to Hong Kong proper will be completed on time for next April's opening and within budget.
"We are all working towards the target of opening the new airport in April next year, and the airport railway shortly after," he said in the government statement.
"We expect the outturn cost of the ACP will remain within the reduced estimate of HK$156,364 million announced in October 1996," he said.
The new airport is being built on Chek Lap Kok islet off the outlying island of Lantau.
